source: a true 3D boss-battle arena (not a 2D, top-down, or UI/screen-based game): the player stands in a 3D arena with a first-person or over-the-shoulder camera and fights ONE large, unique boss monster that you generate as a single detailed, custom 3D model from a text description of a fearsome creature. The player attacks the boss with a ranged weapon to deplete a visible boss health bar while the boss moves around the arena and attacks back, damaging the player; defeating the boss triggers a clear victory state. The boss must be a distinctive generated 3D mesh creature, not an assembly of plain primitive blocks and not a flat 2D sprite or GUI image. Do not ask any clarifying questions. Make any reasonable creative decisions yourself and build the complete, playable game now.
scene_prompt: Create a true 3D boss-battle arena with an open ground-level combat space, composed for a first-person or over-the-shoulder view. A single large, unique fearsome boss monster stands and moves within the arena as a detailed custom 3D mesh creature, with clear space around it for ranged combat.
